title:
There’s something special about making food from ingredients you’ve picked yourself. 🫐🍎

The kids had so much fun picking blackberries from the local parks, so we turned them into homemade blackberry jam and a delicious blackberry & apple crumble. Fresh, simple, and made with memories that cost nothing.

Sometimes the best family days are the simplest ones. ❤️

#Foraging #Homemade #mealprep
